$comment: STASH Android release manifest — deploy this file next to the PWA (Cloudflare Pages serves it at /version.json) or at the URL configured in lib/stash/config.ts (STASH_CONFIG.updates.android.manifestUrl). The in-app 'Check for updates' compares `versionCode`/`versionName` against the installed build and opens `url` externally. This file is intentionally served UNCACHED by the service worker. Bump for every new APK: same applicationId (com.stash.app) + same signing key means Android installs over the existing version and keeps all local data.
notes: First polished Android + PWA release: ten real UI themes, unified STASH branding, theme browser in Appearance, Ko-fi support link, and in-app update checks.
